name: take
title: player:take
lead: Up to `count` (1 unless you say) of what matches, the hand first; answers how many it took.

usedIn.quote: player:take("coal", 8)      -- takes up to 8, the hand first; answers how many it took
player:take({ id = "copper_ingot" }, 2)  -- up to 2 of them; answers how many it took
player:take(COPPER, 2)                    -- an item table matches by its id
